content:
Apple TV subscribers can now watch the first two episodes of Australian kidnapping drama "Last Seen," starring Patrick Brammall ("Glitch"). Watch the trailer below.

"Last Seen" Episodes 1 and 2 are now streaming on Apple TV

Less than a month after Apple TV first announced "Last Seen," the platform has premiered the first two episodes of the new six-episode thriller.

Based on award-winning author Ryan David Jahn's novel "The Dispatcher," new episodes will air every Wednesday through October 7.

"Last Seen" kicks off Apple TV's fall slate, which also includes the Season 6 premiere of "Slow Horses," "Brothers" with Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson, "Matchbox: The Movie," and Season 2 of "Where's Wanda?," among others.

The platform also just premiered "Mayday," starring Ryan Reynolds ("Deadpool") and Kenneth Branagh ("Oppenheimer").
